Describe estimation procedures for methods reporting

Source: R/methods-facts.R
methods_facts.Rd

methods_facts() resolves the smoothing-parameter criterion that cdrgam.fit() uses for a configuration and returns short descriptions of the estimation procedure and the significance tests, each with the keys of the references that support it. Report writers can use these facts instead of restating the defaults and backend behavior of this package.

Usage

methods_facts(
  backend = c("mgcv", "block", "sparse"),
  engine = c("bam", "gam"),
  method = NULL,
  family = stats::gaussian()
)

Arguments

backend, engine, method

As in cdrgam.fit(). method = NULL selects the default criterion.

family

A family object or family name, as in cdrgam.fit().

Value

A list with elements backend, engine (NULL unless the backend is "mgcv"), method (the resolved criterion), criterion and estimator (sentence fragments), citations (a list of reference keys with elements criterion and estimator), and term_tests, a data frame with the columns method (the test labels used by summary() and test_effect()), description, and citation. The reference keys name entries in the bibliography that ships with cdrgam.cli.

Details

The criterion follows the fitting code: with method = NULL, the native mgcv backend uses the mgcv default ("fREML" for bam(), "REML" for gam() with an extended or general family, and "GCV.Cp" otherwise), and the custom backends use REML.
